gameLoopReview.evidence: Executable-contract review only. The public GAME_LOOP contract is falsifiable, but no checked-in consented cohort proves fun, comprehension, pacing, or retention outcomes.

recommendedMoves: Make local feedback attachment explicit and source-true before asking players to publish free text.
Give the weekly command one joined pre-commit rehearsal so the player can challenge or revise the plan before simulation.
Hydrate secondary panels by visited-tab demand instead of issuing twenty-four startup loads.
Bound and validate share-code input before any base64 or JSON work.

Cross-domain decision graph spanning draft, cap, and weekly receipts — rejected for this pass because no shared non-week transaction receipt authority exists yet.

Three-year franchise thesis currency — rejected because the Opening Contract and mastery portfolio already own this conceptual territory.
ui-ux: Explicit attach-preview control for local playtest receipts.
Demand hydration with honest loading/degraded states on first tab visit.

feedback-loop: Consent-gated local receipt attachment with no phantom analytics copy.
Remote automatic telemetry — rejected on custody, cost-neutrality, and lack of consent infrastructure.
gamification-engagement: Weekly plan rehearsal that makes commitment pressure and revision visible.
Daily streaks or random reward currency — rejected as coercive and contrary to deliberate franchise identity.
ai-integration: Deterministic source-derived red-team critique using existing film, pressure, and promise receipts.
Large-language-model coach or outcome predictor — rejected on variable cost, custody, and causal-honesty grounds.
security: Explicit receipt publication consent and bounded note normalization.
Size- and shape-bounded challenge-code parsing before decode.

speed-organization: Tab-owned hydration registry with in-flight deduplication and explicit invalidation.
Another broad app.js split — rejected because reachability is green and file size alone does not prove a runtime defect.
token-api-reduction: Cut twenty-four eager startup API calls to a small visited-tab demand set and measure request-count reduction.
Gameplay model-token optimization — rejected because gameplay makes no model calls and variable free-tier model cost is zero.

items.title: Make every published feedback receipt an explicit player choice
items.premise: Tell the Commissioner says a player chooses whether to attach a local receipt, yet gatherContext automatically reads the newest receipt and buildFeedbackIssueUrl includes its ratings and free-text note. The same flow advertises a Settings analytics opt-in and clipboard digest, but analytics.js has no UI or tracker call sites, so this is a privacy and observability contradiction.
evidence: betaFeedback.js gatherContext always loads receipt[0] before the feedback button is pressed
buildFeedbackIssueUrl emits the receipt note whenever playtestReceipt is present
the UI copy says choose whether to copy or attach, but no attach selection exists
analytics.js exports ten tracker functions and setOptIn; repository search finds no caller outside that module
betaFeedback.js still claims opt in via Settings → Analytics and can describe a copied digest

L1.recipe: Stop auto-attaching receipts and remove the phantom analytics language.

L2.recipe: Add an explicit unchecked attach control plus source preview, attach only the selected bounded receipt, normalize public free text, retire the unwired analytics path, and test consent-on/off URL and clipboard behavior.

L3.recipe: Add a per-receipt publication ledger that records only local consent state and lets the player revoke future selection without deleting the private source receipt.

verification: opening feedback with saved receipts attaches none by default
the player can preview and explicitly select one receipt
only the selected bounded receipt enters the issue URL
no UI claims an analytics opt-in or digest that does not exist
focused browser and pure URL tests cover consent off/on

items.title: Red-team the weekly plan before the franchise commits
items.premise: composeWeeklyPlan collects an optional General Manager choice and tactic, then immediately returns a ready body that advanceOneWeek submits. The player never sees one joined final plan, its strongest live counter-signal, or a revise/cancel boundary before mutation.
evidence: weeklyPlanComposer.js transitions directly from collectTactic to body construction
advanceOneWeek submits the returned body without any plan-review callback
the existing receipt describes composition only after the sequential modals
live command, tactical film, Opening Contract, and chapter sources already provide deterministic evidence without a model call

L1.recipe: Add a final confirm/cancel review callback to composeWeeklyPlan.

L2.recipe: Build a pure source-derived rehearsal model, render a keyboard-safe modal joining decision, tactic, active pressure, franchise promise, strongest counter-signal, and no-causation disclaimer, allow revise/defer/commit, and persist the review outcome in the command receipt only after commit.

L3.recipe: Add a bounded contingency declaration and later compare it descriptively with actual film without awarding hidden bonuses or claiming causation.

verification: no weekly API mutation occurs before explicit review commit
revise returns to composition and defer leaves state unchanged
the critique is deterministic and source-labeled
desktop and mobile share the same rehearsal contract
focused pure and Playwright tests cover commit/revise/defer

items.title: Load franchise panels when the player asks for them
items.premise: queueStartupHydration launches loadSecondaryPanels in the background, and that dispatcher invokes twenty-four loaders in six batches even though the player begins on Overview. There is no tab-to-loader registry, first-visit cache, or regression test for startup request count.
evidence: queueStartupHydration runs the full set immediately after loadCoreDashboard
activateTab does not own data hydration
repository search finds no focused test for queueStartupHydration or loadSecondaryPanels

L1.recipe: Restrict startup hydration to Overview-visible surfaces.

L2.recipe: Create one declarative tab-loader registry with per-authority loaded/in-flight state, hydrate Overview essentials at boot, load each remaining tab on first activation, invalidate exactly after imports/simulation, retain committed-degraded diagnostics, and test request ownership/counts.

L3.recipe: Add priority and idle-budget scheduling plus direct performance receipts for cold start, tab-ready latency, and duplicate-request suppression.

verification: cold boot requests only Overview-visible authorities
first tab activation loads its exact dependencies once
concurrent repeated activation coalesces in flight
simulation/import invalidation refreshes only stale domains
failed loads remain visible and retryable

items.title: Reject oversized or malformed challenge codes before decode
items.premise: decodeChallengeCode trims and splits arbitrary-length input before base64 decode and JSON parse; the public input has no maxlength. A pasted megabyte-scale payload can force avoidable allocation and parsing work on the main browser thread.
evidence: challengeCodes.js has no total-code or payload-body size ceiling
decode accepts any finite seed/year and any non-empty decoded teamId
current tests cover checksum garbage but not oversize, bounds, control characters, or decoded shape

L1.recipe: Add a conservative input maxlength and an early decoder length guard.

L2.recipe: Define one versioned size/shape contract, reject before decode, bound team/year/seed/seasons/name and control characters, mirror the cap in HTML, and add adversarial tests.

L3.recipe: Return typed parse diagnostics for UI guidance while preserving a null-only compatibility adapter for existing callers.

verification: oversized input exits before base64 decode
invalid numeric and string bounds reject
valid historical VSFC1 codes still round-trip
the setup input advertises the same maximum
no dependency or network service is added

executionLog.evidence: Explicit unchecked receipt attachment and bounded preview shipped; phantom analytics path retired. Pure privacy/URL contracts pass in the 35-test focused suite and the feedback browser flow passes in the 12-test app/play-mode suite.
Deterministic source-labeled countercase with commit/revise/defer shipped through the shared composer; 35 focused contracts and the exact first-session Playwright rehearsal path pass.

All 14 tabs now declare owned domains with authority-scoped cache, in-flight coalescing, invalidation, retry-visible failures, and Overview-only cold boot; focused authority tests and 12 app/play-mode browser tests pass.
The VSFC1 parser now rejects overlong and malformed payloads before decode, enforces bounded fields, and mirrors the 512-character cap in HTML; adversarial and historical round-trip contracts pass.
